material.title: Acme opens public beta for an AI procurement agent with spending controls
material.bodyOriginal: Acme today opened a public beta of its procurement agent for small businesses. Admins can set merchant, category and per-order limits; the agent compares offers and prepares an order, while a human must approve payment. The beta is available in the US at no charge through October.

material.title: Acme adds an AI shopping chatbot
material.bodyOriginal: Acme added a chatbot that recommends products using a third-party model. It does not place orders, manage payment or introduce a new authorization flow. Sign up for our course to learn more.
